lines.t:
A <c:ffff00>Leg Type<c> that moves on wheels. Its <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> tend
toward high <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c>. It runs well on
prepared ground, but few terrains suit it.

<c:ffff00>{{terrain|cap}} {{affinity|cap}}<c> ({{mobility}}, <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c>):
  <c:ffff00>{{plains}}<c> +6, <c:ffff00>{{forest}}<c> -4, <c:ffff00>{{rocky_ground}}<c> -4, <c:ffff00>{{sand}}<c> -4,
  <c:ffff00>{{tundra}}<c> -4, <c:ffff00>{{hall}}<c> -4, <c:ffff00>{{waterside}}<c> -4, <c:ffff00>{{cyber}}<c> +4.
  <c:ffff00>{{underwater}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{sky}}<c>: {{robattle|pl}} not possible.
